_comment: Manual curation for the Audion plugin registry. The registry is rebuilt from scratch on every run; anything you set here survives. Match plugins by repo URL (case-insensitive, .git and trailing slash ignored).

_fields.verified: Manually reviewed by the Audion team
_fields.featured: Pinned to the top of the marketplace
_fields.hidden: Kept out of the registry without blocking the repo
_fields.note: Internal note, published as `note` on the entry
_fields.name / description / category / tags / h: Override the value from the plugin's own plugin.json
